note: Two minutes per map, nested out-and-back. speed_tier 'fast' is the spec's name for 1.0-1.5 m/s, which IS ordinary human walking pace (~1.2-1.4 m/s) - the label is the spec's, not a description of how it looks. yaw_tier 'medium' (30-60 deg/s) turns 180 degrees in 3-6 s, which reads as a person looking around rather than a whip pan. The slow yaw tier was rejected on arithmetic: at 15-30 deg/s two 180-degree turns cost 12-24 s, which would eat most of a 35 s revisit budget and leave metre-scale legs.
